snippet.title: Them's Fightin' Herds - Texas Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing Texas the Bull, the first DLC character in the Season 1 Pass, releasing on all platforms Dec 19 at 8am PST!

Them’s Fightin’ Herds is available on PlayStation 4 & 5, Xbox One & Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and Steam.

Buy TFH: https://mane6.com/buy

Website: https://mane6.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/tfh
Twitter: https://twitter.com/mane6dev
Twitch: https://twitch.tv/mane6dev
